subject: English Home Language

source.topic: People who help us: Emergent Reading and Phonics
source.subtopic: Phonics: identifies the 'p' and 't' sounds at the beginning of words and initial and end sounds of community workers' names

show.line: Listen. p as in police. t as in teacher. p, p, police. t, t, teacher!

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with p, as in police?
Say the sound with me. p, as in police! Pop your lips.
Which helper starts with t, as in teacher?
Say the sound with me. t, as in teacher!

rounds.story: Teacher Pule reads to the class. The postman brings a parcel. Who brings the parcel?

rounds.prompt: Does it start with p or t? Put each one in its group.

hints: Listen for the first sound. p, p, police.
t is quick, with your tongue behind your teeth. t, t.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Nurse starts with n. Police starts with p.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. p, p, police. Police starts with p!

parent_line: Can hear the p and t sounds at the start of words.
